_comment: Alpha bbox per scenery sprite: [x0,y0,x1,y1,frameW,frameH] in FRAME pixels, plus each piece's world_px_height and state->sprite map. Measured by games2/scripts/build-scenery-bbox.py so the SERVER can place a scenery hitbox ellipse (live/tuning/scenery_hitbox.json, frame px from the frame centre) into world cells without decoding art. Same definition the client measures at runtime.
